properties.name: MEASURED 2026-09-22: 282 of 312 recorded checks cannot be re-run and 311 read "passing" — the code is heavily tested, the DESIGN'S ACCOUNT of testing is largely unfalsifiable, and that is the half an outside critique of "an AI coding project" actually lands on
properties.statement:
PROMPTED BY AN OUTSIDE READER. Anthony relayed his brother's reaction on 2026-09-22: this "sounds like it is an AI coding project", and his own response was to stop development until testing is under control. The critique is worth recording rather than deflecting, because a measurement taken the same hour partly confirms it — and partly does not, and the line between them is the useful part.

═══ WHAT THE MEASUREMENT SHOWS, taken 2026-09-22 on this tree ═══

THE CODE IS REALLY TESTED. 2,442 `#[test]`/`#[tokio::test]` functions across 272 test files, against 134 source files and 88,815 lines. 50 CI gates run the full set on every push. On this day alone those gates caught three real things: a formatting failure, a drift between two records of one contract, and — unseeded — two cue phrases written into the schema and not into the table. That is not decoration.

THE DESIGN'S ACCOUNT OF TESTING IS MOSTLY UNFALSIFIABLE. And this is where the critique lands:

    Verifications recorded                              312
      reading `passing`                                 311
      WITH NO EXECUTABLE FORM                           282   (only ~30 can be re-run by a machine)
      never run at all                                   46
    Capabilities with a passing check                241/288   (47 have none)
    Artifacts carrying a check of their own            8/426
    Artifact conformance — did anyone confirm it still
      does what its target requires                448/598 unchecked, 139 verified, 11 reviewed
    Capabilities whose evidence names an environment    0/241  (all 241 unplaced)
    Line/branch coverage of the Rust source          NEVER MEASURED — cargo-llvm-cov is not installed
                                                     and no CI step produces a coverage number

⭐ SO THE HONEST SENTENCE IS NOT "reflow2 is untested". It is: THE TESTS ARE REAL AND THE RECORD OF THEM IS NOT. A reader meeting 312 checks at 311 passing would conclude this design is thoroughly verified; 282 of those are assertions somebody wrote that nothing can re-check, and no instrument anywhere reports that reading as weaker than it looks.

⚠️ AND THE MECHANISM TO FIX IT ALREADY EXISTS AND IS BARELY USED — the same three-legs shape this project keeps finding in itself. `req:a-record-can-say-what-runs-it-what-complements-it-and-what-replaced-it` and `cap:record-to-record-relations-are-modelled` mean a Verification can already NAME THE FILE THAT RUNS IT. Thirty of 312 do. The vocabulary is not missing; nothing requires it, nothing reports its absence at the level that would change behaviour, and so it went unused.

🛑 ONE ACCEPTED NON-GOAL SITS IN TENSION WITH FIXING THIS, AND IT MUST NOT BE READ TOO WIDELY. `dec:non-goal-reflow2-does-not-judge-whether-a-check-is-meaningful` says a passing Verification is a claim reflow2 RECORDS and never one it VALIDATES. That is a correct position about reflow2 judging ITS USERS' checks. It is NOT a reason this project cannot hold its OWN design to a harder bar, and treating the two as one question is part of how the record got here. The distinction is a consumer-facing product policy versus this repository's own engineering standard.

WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the 2,442 tests are broad or concentrated. Nothing has measured which lines they reach, so "heavily tested by volume" is the strongest claim the evidence supports — it is not a coverage claim, and it must not be quoted as one.

═══ RE-MEASURED 2026-09-22, THE SAME DAY, AFTER THE WORK THIS FACT MOTIVATED ═══

NOT CLOSED, AND DELIBERATELY SO: the numbers moved and the claim did not. Do not quote the figures above as current; do not read this section as the finding being retired.

  Verifications                    312 → 315
  WITHOUT an executable form       282 → 242
  never run                         46 → 46 (unmoved)
  capabilities verified by a
    check something can re-run      21 → 59 of 293

WHAT RETIRED THE 40, and it is worth knowing because it was not new testing: `link_artifact` drew REALIZES onto a Verification instead of IMPLEMENTS — the wrong edge by the schema's own hint — so 40 checks had a registered file and no executable form. The tool was fixed at the call site and those 46 links were migrated. The tests were never missing; the edge recording them was.

⇒ **77% OF THIS DESIGN'S CHECKS STILL CANNOT BE RE-RUN, so the finding stands.** What changed is that a measurable part of the gap turned out to be a RECORDING defect rather than absent work, which sharpens the finding rather than softening it: "the record is wrong" belongs among the candidates before "the work was not done".
